name: CountrySelect
description:
Choose a country by typing its name: every ISO 3166-1 country, named by the platform in the
locale, with its flag and code. The value is the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code ("AU").
signature: ({ countries, priority, flags, locale: localeProp, value, defaultValue, placeholder, ...rest }: CountrySelectProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name when a visible label does not name the control.

props.name: className
props.description: Layout only. Applied to the control box.

props.name: countries
props.description: Only these ISO codes.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables interaction while retaining the component’s disabled appearance.

props.name: empty
props.description: Text for the empty row. Default: No matches for “query”.

props.name: flags
props.description: Flags beside the names (SVG, lazy; never emoji). Default true.

props.name: id
props.description: A stable element or component identifier.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the control invalid. Pair it with an accessible validation message.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale for the country names and their order. Default: the nearest `LocaleProvider`, then `configureLocale()`, then `<html lang>`, then en-US.

props.name: name
props.description: The component’s name or native form field name, as specified by its value type.

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Called when the text input loses focus, so a form can mark the field touched.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description:
Called with the chosen option's value when one is picked, or null when the selection is
cleared. Typing alone does not call it. Pair with `value` to control it; use `defaultValue` otherwise.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: The prompt shown while the value is empty. It does not replace the field’s label.

props.name: priority
props.description: Codes listed first, in this order: the workspace's own country, then its neighbours. Default ["AU", "NZ"].

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Displays the current value without allowing edits.

props.name: ref
props.description: Receives the underlying element for focus or measurement. React 19 accepts ref as a normal prop.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the field as required; pair it with the corresponding schema validation.

props.name: size
props.description: The token-based size. Touch targets adapt to coarse pointers independently of the selected density.

props.name: value
props.description: The controlled value. Keep it in application state and update it in the change callback.

props.name: width
props.description: Content width: short (port, PIN), medium (name, hostname), full (default).
